mentions.name: Hypertrophy
mentions.description: iOS-native gym workout logging app designed as a minimal, polished "Notes app for the gym" that does few things well. Completely free with no ads, and includes an Import from Strong feature. Available on the App Store.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a simpler, cleaner workout logging experience than Strong and disliked how other workout apps charge for a basic workout experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building Hypertrophy, an iOS-native workout app.

evidence.value: I've been building Hypertrophy, an iOS-native workout app.
